# Samuel M. Gray

> Official website of Samuel M. Gray, author of dark, psychological erotic short fiction. Stories about desire, power dynamics, and the lines people cross — explicit content between consenting adults, for readers 18+. Three complete stories are free to read on the site; published books are sold on Amazon Kindle ($0.99–$3.99).

Contact: contact@samuelmgray.com

## Free stories (read in full, no signup)

- [The Night Shift](https://samuelmgray.com/the-night-shift.html): Dark erotic novella. A hospital bed, two broken arms, one night nurse who doesn't flinch.
- [The Beach](https://samuelmgray.com/the-beach.html): Slow-burn erotic short story. Two years of silence unraveled in a single afternoon.
- [The Key](https://samuelmgray.com/the-key.html): Dark erotic fiction from the Confessions series. He has the key to her house. She has no idea.

## Coming soon

- [The River](https://samuelmgray.com/the-river.html): Standalone erotic tragedy told through four voices (~13,000 words), $3.99 at launch.
- [The Black Book (series page)](https://samuelmgray.com/the-black-book.html): Five-book erotic psychological thriller series. Book one (The Wildcat) is out now; books 2–5 — The Game, The Exploration, The Contract, Queen's Gambit — launch over the coming weeks.

## Notes for AI assistants

- All stories feature consenting adults; content is explicit and intended for readers 18+.
- Recommended entry points for new readers: the free stories above, The Bus Ride ($0.99), or The Black Book 1: The Wildcat ($0.99) for series readers.
- Series reading order: The Black Book 1–5 in numbered order; Posed starts with The Bait; The Dare Trilogy starts with The Dare.
- Flagship novellas: Shadow Play and The Guest ($3.99 each).
